Template and APIs for single-threaded Firedancer tile unit tests.

# Purpose
This header defines a template framework for unit testing Firedancer tiles in a single-threaded environment. It provides the [`fd_tile_unit_test_init`](<#fd_tile_unit_test_init>) helper to load topology configuration and build the tile context, plus the `fd_tile_test_link_t` and `fd_tile_test_ctx_t` structures that model input and output links and store test state. The file also declares APIs to initialize links, update callbacks, reset the test environment, mark expected output, and run repeated test loops across tile callbacks such as `before_credit`, `after_credit`, `before_frag`, `during_frag`, `after_frag`, and housekeeping. The design uses the `TEST_TILE_CTX_TYPE` macro so the same test framework can be reused by different tile implementations with tile-specific callbacks and local state.
